sun.source: work/viewer_1982/shadow_heights/shadow_heights.json: azimuth from the building shadows on DOP1000-1982, elevation from the ephemeris (S03)

d: estate mask (hull of the blocks + 12 m), read by the page only

surfaces.rule: surfaces_1982 (outlines traced off DOP1000-1982 by two readers: sourced) painted over lanes, land cover and aprons, never over buildings, ponds, the river or tree cover; what each is made of is analogue (the photo cannot show tar, concrete or earth): road asphalt, track dirt, footpath concrete, open ground the author's IMG_8982 (OG03)
surfaces.materials_by_feature: a road's own material (asphalt or concrete, inferred from its tone on the photo, curate.py) over the class default
surfaces.lanes_under_trees: the lanes' surfaces run on under tree cover; open ground stops at it (2026-11-05)

yard_ring.rule: a building within 1 m of open ground has open ground 3 m all round it, not on lanes, ponds, tree cover or a permanent building's concrete apron (drawing rule, the author 2026-11-05)

track_grass.rule: rough grass down the middle of a track at least 2.4 m wide (drawing rule, the author 2026-11-05)

splat.rule: classes from the built layers (lanes by kind, land cover, tree cover, 1.2 m concrete apron round permanent buildings, 2 m beaten earth round huts, a mud bed under the ponds and the river); unclassed ground split grass / bare by the photo (bright and smooth = bare): an automated reading, analogue

ground_ortho.note: DOP1000-1982 (S03), building shadows of the sourced sun lifted, because the view renders them; structures not in the model (pending, absent) filled from the ground around them

ring.source: DOP1000-1982 mosaic (S03) at 1 m on the 5 m DTM (S06, today's ground, inferred)

far.source: 5 m DTM (S06), Copernicus GLO-30 DSM north of the boundary (S33); colour analogue

stair_cores.rule: the tab of the sheet outline at the north-side core (outline minus its 3 m opening); presence in Dec 1982 shown by the photo (roof_check: raised structure at the central core, with its own shadow); rise 2.6 m a drawing default; form a plain box, the V parapet of 1975 not drawn

trees.rule: height = 1.5 + 1.15 x crown diameter (analogue); crowns in tree cover 4.5 m apart, camphor, longan and chinaberry in turn; in the fung shui wood west of Ho Sheung Heung 5.0 m apart, 6-10 m wide, a mixed broad-leaved evergreen wood after the 1999 survey (S54), height its 2010/11 canopy top inside 8-18 m (inferred); the banyans 0.75 x their crown width tall; no scattered trunk on a lane: moved 0.5 m off its edge, or left out beyond 4 m (2026-10-29)
